architecture.approach: Keep the public API, permissions, extraction, finalizePlan and creation in Node. Add a stateless Python service at services/document-analyzer managed by uv, built on documind==0.2.2. Node sends the cleaned text and the v1 plan options to POST /v1/plans:analyze over an authenticated private channel. The service invokes DocuMind exactly once with format=md and needs_research=False, reads the generated Markdown, extracts one fenced JSON block, validates it with Pydantic against the shared contract, deletes its temp directory and returns an unfinalised plan. Node validates again with zod, finalises and persists analyzer, model and usage. DOCUMENT_ANALYZER_MODE selects documind or ai; the ai path keeps the v1 provider and BYOK and is the only fallback, allowed on infrastructure failures only. documind is a generation SDK with no analysis API, and its internal pipeline may make several provider calls; both facts are recorded rather than assumed.

dataModel.flowDescription: The browser uploads to the unchanged Node route. Node validates permissions, reads the multipart file in memory, extracts and shortens the text, stores a queued AiPlan and starts runPlan. In documind mode runPlan posts one request to the analyzer with the cleaned text and plan options. The analyzer authenticates, validates with Pydantic, takes a concurrency slot, builds the versioned brief, invokes DocuMind once with format=md, reads the generated Markdown, extracts one fenced JSON block, validates it, deletes its temp directory and returns an unfinalised plan. Node validates with zod, runs finalizePlan for dates and name/key deduplication, persists analyzer, model and usage, and marks the plan ready. The browser keeps polling the existing detail route. In ai mode, or on an allowed infrastructure failure with fallback enabled, Node calls the v1 provider instead and records analyzer as ai.

securityConsiderations.description: The analyzer requires a bearer token of at least 32 bytes from the environment, compared with hmac.compare_digest, refuses to start without it in production, is reachable only on the private network or HTTPS, and keeps provider credentials in its own environment only.
Document text stays in memory, generated files live in a 0700 per-request directory removed in finally, nothing is cached or persisted, and logs carry only requestId, sizes, latency, engine and code.
documind is pinned to 0.2.2 with a hash in uv.lock, runs in an isolated non-root container, is never installed on the host, and any transitive upgrade requires an explicit review.

performanceConsiderations.strategy: At most one HTTP request from Node and one DocuMind invocation per plan; provider calls inside the SDK pipeline are instrumented and recorded rather than assumed to be one.

ANALYZER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS defaults to 200 s inside the existing plan budget; p95 target 180 s for 60,000 characters; a semaphore caps concurrency, excess gets 429 with Retry-After, and Node clamps its own timeout below the budget.
Multi-stage uv build with --no-dev, a warm /healthz, measured image size, cold start and memory; the service is kept warm before traffic.

risks.description: RISK-021: documind generates documents rather than analysing them, so the plan is generated prose parsed from a fenced JSON block and may be less reliable than the v1 schema-constrained call.
risks.mitigation: Versioned brief, exactly-one-block contract, Pydantic and zod validation, golden fixtures, side-by-side review of ten real documents before the default switch, and the ai mode retained.

risks.description: RISK-022: the SDK's LangGraph pipeline may make several provider calls, so one request does not imply fewer AI calls or lower cost.
risks.mitigation: Instrument provider calls, latency and cost on ten documents and publish the numbers before switching the default; keep the v1 single-call path; cap concurrency.

risks.description: RISK-023: the SDK pulls LangGraph, langchain providers, boto3, python-pptx, lxml, Pillow and tiktoken, making the image large and cold starts slow.
risks.mitigation: Multi-stage uv build with --no-dev, no build tools in runtime, measured size/start/memory, warm health check.

risks.description: RISK-024: the package is Beta, publishes no provenance, its declared repository could not be verified, and it installs a top-level src package that can collide with our code.
risks.mitigation: Hash-pinned 0.2.2, isolated container, no host install, app package name, non-root user, diff review before upgrades.

risks.description: RISK-025: document text and generated files cross a process boundary and land on disk.
risks.mitigation: Text only, TLS or private network, 0700 per-request directories removed in finally, no persistence or content logging, redaction tests owned by the Test agent.

risks.description: RISK-026: workspace BYOK is bypassed on the DocuMind path because provider credentials are installation-level.
risks.mitigation: Explicit setting, admin documentation, unchanged per-workspace daily limit, analyzer recorded on every plan, ai mode retained for BYOK.

risks.description: RISK-027: a service outage blocks plan generation when fallback is disabled.
risks.mitigation: Health check, timeout, circuit breaker, explicit fallback flag, stable error codes and one retry action in the UI.
